chat.t: Are you that Fixer who escaped from the Panoticon?
I have a job for you.

o: Who are you?

chat.t: I'm Sergeant Casey of the Donut House.

o: Donut House? Sergeant?
Are you a cop?

chat.t: Yes.
Don't worry. This request has nothing to do with me being a cop.
In fact, it's the kind of job I can only entrust to someone who isn't on the force.
And I won't hold your escape from the Panoticon against you.
I'll pay you well, so you've got absolutely nothing to lose.

o: Hmm.
I'll decide after hearing the details.

chat.t: Fine.
Let's meet up and talk in person first.
Casey shared her location.
Let's meet here tomorrow at 8 PM.
I've sent the deposit, so check your account.
I'm counting on you for this.

lines.t:
The day after I got the message, I headed to the location Casey gave me
just in time for our meeting.

I came out because I was curious
about what kind of job a cop would want to hire me for, but...
Humanitas Alley
Ah, over here.
This is our first time meeting face-to-face, right?
I'm Casey. Nice to meet you.
Right. Anyway.
Why did you ask to meet in such a shady alley?
Well... I didn't want to draw any attention.
I'd prefer if we were the only ones who knew about this job.
You're going to keep the details confidential, right?
Keep it a secret? I haven't even heard what the job is yet.
Ah, I'll explain that now.
The job is to deliver donuts with me.
...? Donut delivery?
You've heard of our donuts from the Donut House before, right?

I don't mean to brag... but since the shop has gotten quite famous,
we've been getting delivery requests from outside Humanitas.

Donut delivery is still strictly a part of my duties,
so delivering outside the city is normally impossible, but...

But I heard a story from a rather special customer this time.
So I'm planning to deliver the donuts on my day off.
A special customer, huh.
Yeah. It's a letter sent all the way from the 'Outer Belt'.
I didn't think people out there would want our donuts too. I was actually a bit touched.
What's the Outer Belt anyway?
Huh? You've never heard of it?
The Outer Belt. A vast, desolate, unclaimed land.
Our destination is a plateau region quite far from Humanitas.
It's so vast that security is poor, and there's no telling what dangers might be lurking...

But the place we're going this time shouldn't be too dangerous.
It's relatively close to the city, at least.
Hmm.
Is something bothering you?
No. I just don't see why I have to go with you.
Don't tell me... since it's a dangerous place, you're planning to use me as a meat shield?
...W-What? Of course not! What do you take me for?!
So we really just have to deliver donuts, and that's it?
...A-Alright, I'll tell you.
Actually, the real job I want to hire you for is something else.
Once the delivery is done, I want to take some photos nearby.
...Photos? Why photos all of a sudden?
Ahem. There's a good spot for photos near there.
Using that as the background, you just... need to take a photo of me.
It's nothing difficult. Just take them exactly how I tell you to.
That's it?
Yes.
...It sounds so easy, which makes it even more suspicious.
Are you planning to kidnap me and sell me off or something?
L-Like I'd ever do that! I'm a police officer!
You're the weird one for thinking it's easy! It's common knowledge that the Outer Belt is dangerous...
...Well, I guess that's why you had the guts to break out of the Panoticon.
So are you trying to use this job as bait to throw me back into the Panoticon?
I wouldn't do something so underhanded!
...Even if I were to arrest you, I'd follow proper procedures and methods.
...Of course, whether you believe me or not is up to you.
So, are you taking the job or not?
Well, if that's the case, why not? I'll do it.
...Y-You are? You're taking it?
...You really are as unpredictable as the rumors say.
Well, anyway... fine. I'll contact you again once the date is set.
See you then. I'll message you the details.
Oh, before that.
Send a 10% deposit first.
...A-Alright.

chat.t: Hey there, Mr. Fixer.
How have you been?
I think I can make some time soon.
How about we go tomorrow or the day after?
If it's too sudden, we can push it back a bit.

o: The sooner, the better.
Let's go tomorrow.

chat.t: Oh, I love the enthusiasm.
Then let's meet where we met last time.

o: By the way, that Outer Belt place or whatever,
How do we get there?

chat.t: We'll take my bike.

o: Then I'll ride on the back.

chat.t: Really? Well, I don't mind.
See you later then.
Good work today.
I've sent the remaining balance, so check your account.

o: ?? What?
We haven't done the photoshoot yet.

chat.t: It was my mistake that we couldn't, so it can't be helped.
I'll request an additional job later or something.
But I think I'll be busy with work for a while.
I'll see how things go and contact you again.
Thanks for today.

lines.t: After meeting up with Casey at the rendezvous point, we headed to the Outer Belt.

Based on the description, it sounded like a dangerous, lawless zone
that doesn't belong to any Division...
Somewhere in the Outer Belt
This place is more normal than I thought.
And here you were, talking like it's super dangerous.
What's wrong? Did something happen?
Y-You shameless bastard!
You kept doing s-strange things from behind...!
Strange things? What do you mean?
You kept groping me all over the place!!
It was so distracting while I was driving...!
Hmm, did I?
I was just holding on tight so I wouldn't fall.
And even though I drove slowly because of that, you kept touching me!!
Y-You shameless pervert...!
More importantly, let's just do the delivery.
We have a lot to do.
Kgh... I-I'm letting you off the hook just this once...!
...Whew. And we still have a way to go to our destination.
This is a sort of rest stop, like the ones scattered all over the Outer Belt.
I just stopped by so we could take a quick break.
So are we taking the photos first?
Ah, no, we're not.
We'll do the photoshoot at sunset.
The timing should be just right once the delivery is done.
A sunset background is my absolute favorite scene.
Your favorite scene?
Hmm, now that I think about it, I should tell you in advance.
Have you ever heard of the Western genre?
It's a passionate tale where sunsets, deserts, cacti, tumbleweeds, guns, horses, and the clash of good and evil intersect.
And as it happens, I hear a filming location for a famous Western movie is near here.
Taking photos there is our real goal.
But did you really have to hire me for this?
You could've just asked someone you know.
That's...
...Well, let's just say I didn't have anyone I could ask for this kind of favor.
I have my position and reputation as a police officer to consider, after all.
I requested you after considering all of that.
A-Anyway, you just need to make sure you take good photos.
Let's rest a bit and head back out—
Hey, you there!!
Huh?
You scoundrels! What on earth is that bizarre contraption!!?
How dare people with two perfectly good legs ride on a vehicle?
I'm so jeal... No, how insolent!
Two perfectly good legs?
...Huh?
W-Wait, no, that's not what I—
...I don't know what you're thinking, but both of my legs are perfectly fine as well.
Though they might look a bit unusual.
Tsk.
Y-Yeah! Why are you making me out to be the weird one!
The point is, that bike of yours is the problem!
Some of us are training hard in this harsh land...
And you keep such a cheap shortcut all to yourselves!?
If you're so jealous, why don't you get one too?
Silence! We are in the middle of sacred training!
Do not try to tempt us with such wicked words!
You're the ones who approached us first, though...
In any case!
For the peace of the realm, we shall confiscate that bike!
Isn't it just that you don't have a ride and want to steal ours?
...Silence!
So this is indeed the Outer Belt.
With law and order this bad, we can't let our guard down for a second.
There are truckloads of guys like them back in Humanitas too.
What are you talking about? There's no way...
...Well, actually, there's no way, is there?
Humanitas is an extremely safe and peaceful city.
Whatever, let's just get out of here.
What do you mean, run away?
Punks like them need to be taught a lesson.
No, we don't have time for this.
You said we have to deliver and take photos.
But I can't just ignore troublemakers right in front of me.
Even if I'm off-duty, that is our duty as police officers.
Sheesh...
Prepare yourselves, villains!
...Whew.
Playtime is over.
Kgh! They're too strong!
T-This cannot be! For me to be defeated...!
You're already surrounded.
So surrender quietly.
Y-You've surrounded us already?!
...Hey, shouldn't we focus on saving our skins first?
No, wait a second.
What are you two whispering about?
...Huh?
Hehehe! We only took those hits to wait for backup!
Hahaha! Foolish bastards, do you realize what's happening now?!
Okay, we really need to run.
Kgh... A-Alright.
Hop on the back when I give the signal.
...Huh? Hey!
Hey! Where do you think you're going!
Hold on tight!
...I think we lost them.
...Huh?
Oh.
Whew, is something wrong?
The donuts kept on the back of the bike were crushed into a mushy mess.
We did ride pretty hard to get away.
...It's my fault.
I completely forgot that we had to deliver the donuts.
...For now, let's head to our destination as planned.
I'll apologize and ask for their understanding. I can't give them... this.
What about the photoshoot?
If we go now, it'll be midnight by the time we arrive. Besides...
...I don't think I have the energy for it today.
Leaving only a lingering sense of regret, our day in the Outer Belt came to an end.

o: Hey, what are you doing?
If you're free, come out for a bit.
Actually, even if you are busy, come out anyway.

chat.t: What is it?
I'm on duty right now, so I'm busy.
Let's talk later.

o: You're always busy.
Pouting for days just because you messed up some silly delivery.

chat.t: What?
Don't speak so lightly of other people's business.
It might just be a silly delivery to you, but it's important to me.

o: Look at you, still holding onto your pride.
Did you redeliver the donuts you messed up?

chat.t: Not yet.
I planned to go back as soon as I had some free time.

o: Cut the excuses.
It looks like you need some of my special tutoring.

chat.t: Special tutoring?

o: I'll teach you the secret to never failing.
A secret that works anytime, anywhere—whether it's for a job or a donut delivery.

chat.t: There's no way such a convenient secret exists in this world.
And 'never failing'?
Then why are there so many bad reviews for your office?

o: Every superstar has their haters.
Stop grumbling and just get out here.

chat.t: {player}shared a location.

o: If you don't show up, you'd better look forward to your shop's reviews.

chat.t: Wait. What is that supposed to mean?
Answer me.
I asked what you meant.
Hey, you!

o: We're going tomorrow, so get ready.

chat.t: Fine.
And delete those photos.

o: No way.

chat.t: Delete them.

o: No way.

chat.t: Delete them.

o: No way.

chat.t: Delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them delete them

o: We'll see how you do tomorrow.

chat.t: I said delete them delete them asdfghjkl!

lines.t: Humanitas Park
Huff, puff!!
Oh, you're here.
What on earth are you up to! Ignoring my messages too!!
I clearly told you I was working, and yet you pull such a cheap blackmail threat...!!
I came here just like you wanted, so you'd better explain yourself!
I've been thinking about this ever since we went to the Outer Belt.
You really need to soften up a bit.
...W-What?
A soft donut tastes much better than a hard one, right?
...Sigh. What are you even trying to say?
I'm not in the mood for jokes right now.
Especially when I'm already busy with other work...
So, how long are you going to stay busy?
Aren't you going back to the Outer Belt?
...That has nothing to do with you anymore, does it?
My commission is over. I've already paid you in full.
That's exactly what's bothering me.
Getting paid when I didn't actually do anything.
...So what do you want to do about it?
I told you, I'm going to give you some special tutoring.
...Sigh.
Fine. I just have to do this 'special tutoring' or whatever, right?
It'd be a waste to go back empty-handed since I'm already here...
...So, what do I have to do?
It's simple. Just do exactly what I tell you to do.
But make sure you don't panic, no matter what happens.
...Understood.
What are you going to make me do?
First, we're going to the nearby children's playground. And there...
Get on the <bouten>Rocking Horse</bouten>, Casey.
...W-What? A playground? A rocking horse?!
What kind of... nonsense are you talking about all of a sudden?!
It won't be easy to keep your balance on a small rocking horse.
If your physical balance is shaken, you'll panic more easily.
The goal of this special tutoring is to maintain your composure even in a situation like that.
That makes absolutely no—
Quiet. Didn't you say you'd do as I say?
Just tell me, are you going to do it or not?
...A-Alright, I get it.
Also, hand over your weapons and handcuffs.
I'll keep them safe for a bit. You might get hurt if you have bulky things hanging off you.
I-Is that so...? Th-Thanks.
D-Do I get on like this?
No, turn around and lean against it.
And if I do this...
...Huh?
...Hmm.
This is working better than expected.
I untied Casey, who had been bound to the toy rocking horse.
Haaah...
Hey, wake up.
Hyaah!
...W-Where am I...?
Are you back with us?
What on earth...
Y-You bastard! Why are you doing this to me?!
You said this was special tutoring, so why are you doing something so cruel?!
...A-Are you getting revenge on me now for being locked up in the Panoticon...?!
I don't hold grudges like that.
Besides, you weren't even there back then.
Th-Then why on earth are you doing this?!
You're the one who said you'd teach me the secret to never failing!
And then you tie me to a kids' toy and do... s-strange things to me!!
Well, you seem a bit softer than before you got on.
Let's hurry up and head out before the effects of the training wear off.
Where do you think we're going!
The Outer Belt.
Oh.
...Ugh. O-Of course we're going.
It's just... I'm still a bit busy with work, and...
I-I'm not quite mentally prepared yet...
I figured as much, so I prepared something to motivate you.
I took photos of you working hard during your training earlier.
...Photos?
...!! Don't tell me you?!
We can leave tomorrow, right?
If you say no, I might be too heartbroken and leak them...
You bastard! Is this why you called me out?!
Y-You shameless bastard!!
Sometimes, the world needs a villain.
Well, I'm off. See you tomorrow.
Hey, you punk!!!

o: Are you ready to go?
Hmm, no reply.
Now, where did I save those photos...

chat.t: Fiine im on my waay

o: And you prepared the thing we talked about earlier, right?

chat.t: Seriosuly
Are you really going to use that?

o: I don't care if we don't.
But you said we had to.

chat.t: Then let's not do it.
I don't think we need to go this far.

o: Hmm, then I guess I have no choice.
Now, where did I save those photos...

chat.t: What do you want me to do then!!!

lines.t: Somewhere in the Outer Belt
...Man, I'm exhausted...
Isn't there a bike passing by around here?
Tell me about it.
We should've hijacked that bike we saw at the rest stop the other day, no matter what.
Next time, as soon as we see it, we'll grab it and...
...Huh?
Yo, found you at last.
Wh-What?!
Y-You guys are...!!
Khehe! To think I'd see that bike again in my lifetime!!
Hahaha, what a pleasure! Alright, pleasantries are over, so hand over that bike!
Hold on, before that.
You guys need a ride, right?
I-In that case, wouldn't you be interested in something way more special than this?
Like, for example, being able to eat the wheels when you're hungry...
W-What?! There's a bike like that?!
Oho, a ride that satisfies hunger! I am truly intrigued!
Then take a look at this.
Wh-What on earth is this?!
H-How can this be?!
I-It's the ultimate masterpiece of the Donut House, the 'Donut Bike'...
A-A Donut Bike!!!
Oh...! This is a miracle of the wilderness...!!
Like it? Then it's a gift for you.
You're just giving this to us?! Are you guys Santa?!
Thank you! I shall never forget this favor!!
It's nothing. Well, we'll be on our way.
O-On our way...
Khehe! This is going to make getting around so much easier!
Hey! This wheel actually tastes like chocolate!
...Huh?! What's that sound?!
Oh, this cold, sharp sensation piercing the tip of my tongue...?
Gyaaah!!
The Donut Bike exploded!!
After that, they probably won't think about hijacking anyone else's ride anytime soon.
...Sigh.
To think a police officer just assisted in a bomb delivery...
Your donuts aren't bombs.
There just happen to be some donuts that explode occasionally.
...R-Right. That must be it, right?
T-That's right! There are no limits to the Donut House's donuts!
Our baker merely proved one of the many endless possibilities that a donut holds!
And...
In the end, we successfully finished the original delivery.
...I had to cast aside a lot of things to get here, but let's put that aside for now...
Yeah, that's the mellow spirit.
Pfft... What are you even talking about?
Anyway, now all that's left is the photoshoot...
...Huh?
Yaaah!!!!!!
Whoa, you startled me.
What is it now?
The sun is setting!!
We need to go take the photos right now!!
Just take it here.
No! Not here! We're going to the shooting location right now!
Hurry up and get on! I'm going to push this thing to the limit!
Ah, I need to use the bathroom.
Hey, you punk!!!

chat.t: When on earth are you coming out?
Are you planning to live in the bathroom all day?
Why are you doing this to me?

o: Are you always this obsessive?

chat.t: It's already getting dark!
Hurry up already, please!!
Did you get home safe?
Thanks for today.
Regardless of how we got there...
I never expected your after-sales service to be this good.

o: You've really grown.
Learning how to be sarcastic and all.

chat.t: I'm not being sarcastic, I mean it!
You've got some nerve talking to a police officer like that.

o: Oh right, I forgot you were a cop.

chat.t: What do you mean 'oh right'!
Whatever. That's just who you are.
Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you.
I don't know if I'll ever have another commission for you.
Try to stay out of trouble.
So I don't have to arrest you myself.
See you around, Fixer.

lines.t: Why are you so late!
Hurry! If we floor it now, we might just make it in the nick of time...!
Calm down.
You remember the secret technique I taught you yesterday, right?
...Y-You bastard.
You'd better answer me honestly.
...You weren't hiding somewhere just to mess with me, were you?
Why did you suddenly go quiet, you punk! Answer me!!
No, I just had some things to buy.
Let's just get going.
It's already too late!
It'll be the middle of the night by the time we arrive!
Well, let's wait and see about that.
...What?
Somewhere in the Outer Belt
Ugh, for it to suddenly pour like this...
And as I thought, it's completely pitch black now...
...Sigh, there's nothing we can do.
Let's go back. At least we finished the donut delivery safely.
Go back? No way.
This place is perfect.
...What do you mean by that?
In a place like this, taking the photos I wanted will be...
Not that way, this way.
Huh?
This looks perfect.
Come over here.
...Hey, wake... up.
Urgh, five more minutes...
Hey, you punk! I told you to wake up!!
Fine, I'm up...
Somewhere in the Outer Belt
...Huh? Where am I?
...You're still half-asleep.
Do you not remember what happened yesterday?
Mmm...
I think we were talking about something, and then I fell asleep.
...You are unbelievable.
Sleeping so peacefully in the middle of a barren wasteland without a care in the world.
If things had gone slightly wrong, you could've gotten frostbite.
But it wasn't really that cold?
Th-That's because I was huddled next to you!
I-I-I-I had no choice!
Th-That was the only way to maintain our body heat!!
Aha, no wonder it felt so soft while I was sleeping.
Urgh! Y-You shameless bastard...!!
...Sigh, whatever.
I've had more than enough of your shamelessness over the past few days.
And besides, it was because of that side of you that I was able to gather up some courage...
...Anyway! Since you're awake, get ready.
We're going back now.
By the way, when did you change back?
It's a shame, it really suited you.
O-Of course I had to change!
How am I supposed to work wearing something like that?!
What, you have work today too?
...Sigh, yeah.
Thanks to you, I'm about to be late for the first time since I joined the force.
And I already have a backlog of donut deliveries...
How on earth are you going to take responsibility for this?
It's fine to be late every now and then.
You look much better now that you've softened up.
Seriously, what does 'softened up' even mean...
...Geez, always talking in riddles.
What are you doing? I thought you said we should hurry.
...I'm going.
Cheeky bastard.
